opportunity.title: Connecting Health - Clinical Data Repository (CDR) and openEHR

supports: openEHR REST and FHIR API interoperability
integrated openEHR and FHIR digital-health platform
ABAC access controls and audit logging
hospital, government health-system and NHS use evidence
ability to incorporate external specialist partners around Better Platform delivery

why_candidate_is_plausible: The buyer's public notice requires a centralised CDR and an openEHR-compliant platform; Better publicly sells an openEHR CDR/platform.
The public notice calls for real-time access and interoperability; Better publicly documents event-driven real-time flows plus openEHR/FHIR APIs.
The buyer's public notice allows joint bids/partnerships where appropriate; Better publicly operates a partner programme.
Better has a UK entity and public business route, reducing routing ambiguity.
unknowns: Whether Better is already bidding DN827803.
Whether Better wants any subcontractor or specialist workshare.
The controlling tender-pack evaluation, security, clinical-safety, legal, commercial and submission requirements.
Whether the buyer's final tender rules permit the proposed specialist seam.
Whether Better can evidence every buyer-specific reference, certification, staffing and contractual gate.

scope: interface conformance and replay/idempotency acceptance evidence
acceptance traceability from agreed technical requirements to inspectable evidence
explicit_exclusions: live patient-data handling before separately authorized controls
claims of savings, award, acceptance or booked revenue
acceptance_hypothesis: Agreed interface and migration-object inventory is versioned and traceable.
Every sampled acceptance case binds requirement, input, observed result, evidence and disposition.
Duplicate, stale, missing and out-of-order scenarios have deterministic expected outcomes.
Migration/reconciliation exceptions are classified, ownered and reproducible.
Unresolved blockers remain explicit rather than being relabeled as pass.

outbound.intent: Ask whether Better is pursuing Jersey DN827803 and, if so, whether it wants a bounded paid acceptance-evidence/interoperability specialist workshare; £18,000 fixed commercial hypothesis, subject to pack/prime fit.
required_before_send: immediate final Slack+Gmail recensus after Muse
exactly one provider send only if still collision-free
